kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Orders per surface are in §5–§11. Shared: no refresh, pill or job steals focus; dialogs focus Cancel, Tab in reading order → Cancel → the confirm, Esc cancels, focus returns to the opener (`05:97`); steppers focus the step heading (D27); grids are APG grids with roving `tabindex` and `aria-rowindex` when windowed. Voices (D02:686-695; D04 §12): a bad state, a refusal, a failed job — assertive once; recovery, results, new rows, saved steps — polite once; "{n} %" polite at 25 % steps; "as of", ages and countdowns never. Targets 32 px (≥ 24 px); the `color.focus.ring` 2 px offset. Every figure's accessible name carries its unit in words ("820 megabytes", "210 milliseconds", "48 percent", "60 frames per second, 95th-percentile frame time 12 milliseconds", "2 chain trips", "step 3 of 8"); the visible text keeps the short form, and an age carries its absolute UTC time in its description (D02:119). (E42-D05 §13 L686)
